wiki.title: Alan Armstrong
wiki.extract: Alan Stuart Armstrong (born July 11, 1962) is an American politician and businessman serving as the junior United States senator from Oklahoma, a seat he has held since March 2026. A member of the Republican Party, he served from 2011 to 2025 as the CEO of the oil and gas company Williams.
